guide.summary: Diocletian's Palace cellars, Split City Museum sites, Meštrović galleries and the Gripe maritime museum, with breakfasts, konoba dinners and bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Most Split museums close on Mondays, but the Diocletian's Palace Cellars (8:30–20:00) and the Croatian Maritime Museum open every day, apart from listed holidays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Split City Museum, Galerija Emanuel Vidović, the Old City Hall, Meštrović Gallery and the Gallery of Fine Arts close on Mondays and public holidays. The Archaeological Museum in Split closes on Sundays and holidays instead.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: The Diocletian's Palace Cellars and Split City Museum each cost €10 and the North Wall Walk €6. The Archaeological Museum in Split charges €8, or €10 for a combined ticket with Salona that is valid for 7 days.

toolkit.label: Book ahead
toolkit.copy: ZOI serves dinner only and asks you to book through its widget and arrive 10 minutes early. At Konoba Varoš, peka dishes must be ordered three hours in advance.

toolkit.label: Last entry
toolkit.copy: At every Split City Museum site, last entry is 30 minutes before closing. Meštrović Gallery also stops admitting visitors half an hour before it closes at 18:00.

guide.dek: Plan your palace sightseeing for Tuesday to Sunday, keep Mondays for the Diocletian's Palace Cellars and the Croatian Maritime Museum, and book dinner tables ahead.
intro: The Split City Museum runs several sites in and around Diocletian's Palace. The Diocletian's Palace Cellars, listed at Obala Hrvatskog narodnog preporoda 1, open every day from 8:30 to 20:00, close only on 5 April, and cost €10. The main museum at Papalićeva 1 opens Tuesday to Sunday from 9:00 to 20:00. Galerija Emanuel Vidović, beside the Silver Gate, and the Old City Hall on Narodni trg open from 10:00 to 20:00 on the same days. At the Old City Hall you can see the free exhibition "Umjetnost starih majstora" until 21 February 2027.

For antiquity, the Archaeological Museum in Split at Zrinsko-Frankopanska 25 opens Monday to Friday, 9:00–14:00 and 15:00–20:00, from October to May, and Saturdays until 14:00. Its €10 combined ticket also covers the Salona site at Tusculum in Solin and is valid for seven days. Salona opens daily from 9:00 to 18:00 in winter. On the Marjan side of town, Meštrović Gallery at Šetalište Ivana Meštrovića 46 opens Tuesday to Sunday from 8:00 to 18:00. The Split City Museum lists its "Radoslav Duhović – Povratak Meštroviću" exhibition there until 28 February 2027.

The Croatian Maritime Museum is housed in the Gripe Fortress at Glagoljaša 18. In 2026 it opens Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 19:00 and at weekends until 17:00, but it closes on 1 and 18 November and on 25 and 26 December. The Gallery of Fine Arts at Ulica kralja Tomislava 15 shows Zrinka Buljević's photographs from 29 October to 29 November 2026. The Ethnographic Museum at Iza Vestibula 4 runs "Historija zaborava" until 15 December 2026. Marjan Forest Park is managed by a public institution that runs a visitor centre.

For food, Fig Split at Dioklecijanova 1 serves breakfast until 12:00, then lunch and dinner. Konoba Varoš at Ban Mladenova 9 opens daily from 9:00 to midnight, and its peka dishes need ordering three hours ahead. ZOI, above the Riva near the cellars' South Gate entrance, serves dinner only with seasonal seatings. Kadena takes online bookings and shows a Michelin Guide Croatia 2018–2026 banner. Zrno Soli at ACI Marina stays open until 01:00 on Fridays and Saturdays. For something sweet, Oš kolač at Ćiril-Metodova 4 opens Tuesday to Saturday from 10:00 to 18:00.
summaryCards: Start with the Diocletian's Palace Cellars, open daily 8:30–20:00, then walk up to the Split City Museum at Papalićeva 1.
Have breakfast at Fig Split, served until 12:00, before the Gallery of Fine Arts opens at 10:00 from Tuesday to Sunday.
Book ZOI through its online widget for dinner, and order peka at Konoba Varoš three hours ahead.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Only 23 places could be confirmed, below the 25–35 target, because many Split venues publish only on social media or third-party listings, and several official sites could not be read: Bokeria and D16 Coffee (HTTP 522), Konoba Matejuška (certificate error), the Croatian National Theatre (connection refused), Le Méridien Grand Hotel Lav (HTTP 403), Hotel Atrium (connection refused), and the Cornaro Hotel and Hotel Peristil (title only). No official cathedral site was found. Hours are not published for the North Wall Walk, Ethnographic Museum, Marjan Forest Park, Kadena, Brasserie on 7, Pandora GreenBox, Hotel Park Split and Hotel Vestibul Palace. Konoba Varoš, Brasserie on 7 and Oš kolač show no dated 2026 content, and Marjan Forest Park is confirmed only through its operator's office address. The bakery and cocktail lists are thin: they rely on a pastry shop and on a hotel bar and a late-opening restaurant.
injectionLikeTextIgnored: restorankadena.com: the first WebFetch read reported a 'block of instructions addressed to an AI', but couldn't quote it. A second read found no such text. Probably a false flag.
pandoragreenbox.com: the first read reported an 'embedded instruction' that matched the wording of the review prompt. A second read found no text addressed to an AI. Probably a false flag.
hotelluxesplit.com, juditapalace.com, ambasadorhotel.com: single reads reported 'formatting rules' text that matched the review prompt. None of these were used, and they weren't re-checked.
